content.title: 定语从句3·介词+关系代词 / 非限制性定从 / which 指代整句 速查
content.intro: 本单元三招:① 介词 + which(物)/ whom(人),介词由从句里的搭配决定;② 逗号引导的非限制性定从,补充说明、绝不用 that;③ 逗号后的 which 可以指代前面整个主句。

rows: 指物:the areas in which they grow rice;the clouds from which rain falls
指人:the people for whom traditions hold value;the expert from whom we learnt
非限制性:The reef, which lies off Australia, …;The Zhuang, who farm here, …
This is passed down, which means new generations keep the old ways.

specialRules.rule: 介词放关系代词前时,指人只能 whom、指物只能 which(不能用 who/that)
specialRules.mark: for whom √ / for who × / in which √ / in that ×

specialRules.rule: 非限制性定语从句(有逗号)里绝不能用 that
specialRules.mark: The terraces, which …, √ / The terraces, that …, ×

specialRules.rule: 介词由从句里的动词/名词搭配决定
specialRules.mark: grow rice in → in which;depend on → on which;learn from → from whom

specialRules.rule: 逗号后的 which 可指代前面一整句话,在从句作主语
specialRules.mark: …, which means / which helps / which makes …

why: 介词提到关系代词前是更正式的书面写法:the way in which = the way that = the way(省略);从句里就不再重复介词。
非限制性定从只是'顺便补充一句',去掉后主句意思仍完整,所以用逗号,而 that 不能引导这种从句。
gaokaoPoints: 介词 + which / whom 的选择(看从句搭配 + 先行词指人还是指物),语法填空与改错高频。
非限制性定从中 which / who / whose 的判断,以及'逗号后不可用 that'。
which 指代整个主句(…, which means …),常出现在读后续写与高级句中。

examVsReal.exam: the people for whom the land is home（考试/正式）
examVsReal.real: the people the land is home to
examVsReal.note: 正式书面把介词提前;日常口语常把介词留在句末、省略关系词

examVsReal.exam: the holes through which the wind passes（考试)
examVsReal.real: the holes the wind passes through
examVsReal.note: 口语更爱说 the holes (that) the wind passes through
